profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which its site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12 covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The company says the site is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics, with interactive questions, awards, and certificates. It describes the product as personalized learning with a comprehensive K-12 curriculum, individualized guidance, and real-time analytics.

IXL Learning also offers Vocabulary.com, an adaptive vocabulary practice tool for students and teachers. Pricing for IXL has been reported at a classroom license from $299/year for 25 students and family plans from $9.95/month, though those figures come from a secondary source. Vocabulary.com district licenses are quoted individually, and one Florida district approved a 3-year contract for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127.
